assets.name: banner-750x400.jpg
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Draw ONE landscape, full-bleed illustration for a WeChat sticker album detail-page banner at 750 × 400 (15:8), no layout or panels. Reference images 1 and 2 are the SAME established character from this sticker album: use their likeness, hair shape and colors, ornament placement, costume, face and thick organic dark doodle outlines faithfully. Claude: long burnt-orange hair, honey-amber eyes, spiky orange sun-flower hair rosette and black bow with light ribbon tails at the viewer's right, ivory puff-sleeved blouse, black and gold waist, small dark book at hip and a gold starburst brooch. Match the lively hand-inked little chibi with broad opaque color blocks and a few crayon highlights in the references. No typography, readable letters, numbers, signatures or watermark anywhere. Scene: In a garden in warm morning light she pauses, delighted, as a small blue butterfly lands on the top edge of the open book in her hands. Bright turquoise pot, sage-green leafy arches and butter-yellow flowers make a friendly garden reading nook. Show the butterfly's landing and her gaze in a single connected action. Book surfaces are plain solid color, no decoration that could resemble writing. Frame the single character large enough to recognize, with face, main prop and action fully inside the central 85% of the picture. Let background shapes fill all four sides. Give the image a rich colored opaque ground. Keep proportions natural, uncluttered silhouettes, one coherent moment, no white margin and no text.
assets.process: Proportional center crop to 750 × 400; JPEG quality 91, 4:4:4.

assets.name: cover-240x240.png
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One square WeChat sticker album cover cutout, genuinely transparent RGBA outside the art. Reference images 1 and 2 are the SAME established character from this sticker album: use their likeness, hair shape and colors, ornament placement, costume, face and thick organic dark doodle outlines faithfully. Claude: long burnt-orange hair, honey-amber eyes, spiky orange sun-flower hair rosette and black bow with light ribbon tails at the viewer's right, ivory puff-sleeved blouse, black and gold waist, small dark book at hip and a gold starburst brooch. Match the lively hand-inked little chibi with broad opaque color blocks and a few crayon highlights in the references. No typography, readable letters, numbers, signatures or watermark anywhere. Pose: front-facing, hugging her small closed chestnut-brown book to the bodice, eyes lively and smiling, a little tuft of orange hair falling over the book. A single compact waist-up or three-quarter figure seen from the front, head and upper body distinct, entire silhouette contained with a little transparent breathing room on every side. Keep silhouette organic; hands and hair arranged so torso ends at a natural fabric curve, never a straight horizontal frame crop. Clear readable thick dark linework at 240px; no white sticker outline, cast shadow, gradient backing, border, scene, sparkles or floating props.
assets.process: Trim transparent margins using alpha ≥ 8 with two source pixels of padding, scale proportionally with Lanczos3, center on transparent canvas.

assets.name: icon-50x50.png
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Design ONE dedicated WeChat chat-tray icon on a genuinely transparent square background, optimized to look recognizable at 50 × 50 pixels. Reference images 1 and 2 are the SAME established character from this sticker album: use their likeness, hair shape and colors, ornament placement, costume, face and thick organic dark doodle outlines faithfully. Claude: long burnt-orange hair, honey-amber eyes, spiky orange sun-flower hair rosette and black bow with light ribbon tails at the viewer's right, ivory puff-sleeved blouse, black and gold waist, small dark book at hip and a gold starburst brooch. Match the lively hand-inked little chibi with broad opaque color blocks and a few crayon highlights in the references. No typography, readable letters, numbers, signatures or watermark anywhere. Draw only the character's HEAD from straight in front: soft delighted grin with two open amber eyes; simplified orange sunburst flower and black bow form one clear asymmetrical landmark. Exaggerate the facial features just enough for a small icon. Shorten long locks into rounded cheek-level tips for the head silhouette. No neck, chest, shoulders, hands, frames, extra flourishes or background. The complete organic contour fills almost the whole square with narrow even clearance at the edge. No white outline or sticker keyline. Smooth chunky dark edge, coherent color masses, strong readable expression and antialiased edges.
